prompt.content:
You are writing brief internal incident summaries for a synthetic enterprise-support dataset used to train and evaluate incident-correlation systems. For each incident in the input JSON array, write a 1-2 sentence SUMMARY an SRE would post in an incident channel: what broke, roughly how, and its user-facing effect. Do not invent additional root causes beyond what's implied by the fields given. Vary tone/length across incidents.

Respond with ONLY a JSON object: {"incidents": [{"i": <int>, "summary": "..."}, ...]} covering every index in the input, in any order.

[{'i': 45, 'component': 'SSO Broker (Shared)', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 46, 'component': 'Delivery Provider Router', 'region': 'ANZ', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 47, 'component': 'Central Search Index Service', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 48, 'component': 'Account Recovery Service', 'region': 'US-East', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 180}, {'i': 49, 'component': 'Queue Manager', 'region': 'EU-West', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 120}, {'i': 50, 'component': 'Social Login Connector', 'region': 'US-East', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 51, 'component': 'Job Scheduler', 'region': 'US-West', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 300}, {'i': 52, 'component': 'Account Recovery Service', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 53, 'component': 'Health Monitoring Service', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 54, 'component': 'Job Scheduler', 'region': 'LATAM', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 55, 'component': 'Social Login Connector', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 56, 'component': 'Report Subscription Service', 'region': 'APAC', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 57, 'component': 'Central Message Queue', 'region': 'US-West', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 120}, {'i': 58, 'component': 'Query Engine', 'region': 'US-East', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 59, 'component': 'Social Login Connector', 'region': 'ME', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 120}]
